chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 信托和公司服务提供商（TCSP）应通过以下方式应对洗钱风险：（选择三项。）

options.A: 在为客户处理交易时建立双重控制和质量保证措施
options.B: 考虑当客户通过位于另一司法管辖区的另一家信托和公司服务提供商（TCSP）下达指令时，可能需要采取哪些额外的保障措施
options.C: 要求客户完成并向所在司法管辖区的金融情报机构（FIU）提交反洗钱风险自我评估表
options.D: 从客户处收集并记录信息，以了解法律实体的目的，以及管理人员和最终受益所有人的身份。
options.E: 建立相关程序，以记录信托和公司服务提供商（TCSP）作为客户注册官的依据，并保存相关参与记录

stem_en: Trust and company service providers (TCSPs) should address money laundering risk by: (Select three.)

options_en.A: Establishing dual controls and quality assurance practices when processing transactions for the client
options_en.B: Considering what additional safeguards may be required when client instructions are given through another TCSP located in another jurisdiction
options_en.C: Requiring the client to complete and submit an AML risk self-assessment to the jurisdiction's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
options_en.D: Gathering and recording information from clients to understand the purpose of the legal entity, as well as the identity of managers and ultimate beneficial owners
options_en.E: Establishing procedures to document the basis on which the TCSP will act as a registered officer for the client and retaining records of that involvement
